name: Fajita-Style Pork Bowl with Bell Peppers, Onions, Kale & Lime Sauce
instructions: Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix; set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips; add to the baking sheets with the bell pepper.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board; thinly slice crosswise into bite-sized strips. Add to the baking sheets, sprinkle with ⅔ of the spice mix, then drizzle with oil; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
Place baking sheets in the oven and roast until veggies start to soften, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander. Add beans to the bowl with the kale along with oil and salt; toss to combine.
When the veggies are soft, add kale and beans to the baking sheets; toss to combine, then return to the oven and continue to bake until kale is tender and pork is cooked through, 6-7 minutes more.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lime into the bowl with the remaining spice mix; add yogurt and water, then stir to combine the sauce.
To serve, divide pork, beans, and veggies between bowls; drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
author: Mealime
